notes: Character avatars: choose one of the five characters (Mohawk, Bird, Cowboy, Monster, Bunny Scientist) - or keep the orb only - from the new Avatar row on Home or in Settings. The character fronts DOST on the Home screen with the orb as its glow: it floats while idle, brightens and leans in while you speak, sways gently while thinking, and pulses while DOST talks. Your choice is saved and survives restarts. Everything from v0.9.1 (voice + AI fixes and Diagnostics) is included.
